title: Station Meridian Rising Anew
author: Astrid Hartwell
blurb: Bram Galloway, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
